# `tool-title-missing`

**Tool rule** · `info` · **off by default**, enable it to use it

A title is what a client shows a person when it lists or confirms a tool; without one the name is shown as is.

A tool rule judges one tool from its own definition, so it runs everywhere: `lint()`, `lintTools()`, the CLI, the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler and the ESLint plugin.

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "tool-title-missing": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "tool-title-missing": "warning" } }); // change severity
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule tool-title-missing=off
```

```js
// eslint.config.js
{ rules: { "webmcp/tool-title-missing": "error" } }
```
